cases.name: Amy Lynn Eckhoff De la Cruz
cases.about:
Her obituary said, "She touched the lives of many through her care and compassion. She was known for her kindness and selflessness, always prioritizing others before herself. 

Amy will be remembered fondly for her love of travel, enjoyment of beach outings, and cherished moments spent with her beloved dog. Her warm and fun-loving personality endeared her to all who knew her.

In honor of Amy's generous spirit and caring nature, may we carry forward her legacy of love and compassion in our own lives. May she rest in peace knowing that she made a positive impact on those around her."
cases.narrative: Officers found her shot to death inside a 2023 Freightliner semi-truck. The vehicle had been leased to Young and he was the registered operator.
